verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs describe log-based alerts configured with a metric (e.g. Cost, Correctness, Context Adherence), an aggregation function, a threshold and a time window, which covers cost spikes and eval-score drops. The pack never says where those alerts are delivered, so the notification half of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented Slack/PagerDuty/email notification channels, explicit error-rate alerting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
